name: app-white-login-schedule-and-signup-screens-on-white
title: Account access flow in black and white: login, workout scheduler and sign-up
whatItIs: A white board titled 'Account Access' with three staggered phones: a welcome login with grey filled inputs and black Continue, a scheduler with a photo of two people training and a date picker sheet, and a sign-up form with icon fields.
whatItMeans: Clean, direct and confident; black-on-white buttons and filled fields make forms feel effortless.
techniques: Use grey filled inputs with small left icons.
Keep one wide black primary button per screen.
Introduce a photo header above a bottom sheet for a motivating moment.
Present a two-tone title with the second word dimmed.

vocabulary.definition: A field with a soft grey background.
A scrolling selector for dates or numbers.
A photo above a rounded white bottom sheet.
